news.title: A renewed push to ban seclusion, reduce restraint in Michigan schools
news.summary_en: Michigan students were secluded or restrained nearly 18,000 times during the 2024-2025 school year. Advocates say more staff training and an emphasis on prevention would help students.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Michigan universities make secret decisions; some lawmakers want change
news.summary_en: A 1999 Michigan Supreme Court ruling has allowed publicly funded universities to make most decisions behind closed doors, say those trying to change the situation.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: Michigan is spending $150M on one-time ‘educator’ bonuses. Here’s how it works
news.summary_en: Michigan starting teacher pay is near the bottom while average teacher pay is middle of the pack. One lawmaker says the bonuses can help offset rising costs.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
